subject: Subscription top-up and acceptance gating for ClearBay
messages:
From: Michael Stevens <michael.stevens@clearbayhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearbayhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Subscription top-up request + SOW attached

Laura,

Hope you had a good weekend. Quick one — we ran a capacity dry-run during Friday's pilot spike and we need to secure a short-term commitment to cover an expected 2.5x token throughput for the next 90 days (pilot -> prod ramp).

Our procurement asked that we coordinate this via the AWS Marketplace private offer path so billing sits with our existing PO process. Attached is the SOW v3 with the updated usage estimates and the billing cadence we prefer (monthly tranches).

Can your team confirm:
- Whether Redwood can create a private offer amendment for a 3-month top-up (committed tokens) that sits on top of our existing private offer?
- If staged acceptance windows are required for the new capacity?
- Any evidence/evidence package you need for Marketplace acceptance?

Thanks — we want to avoid contract churn but need the capacity in 10 business days.

—Michael
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearBay Health

Attachment: ClearBay_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW summary, usage table)

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Michael Stevens <michael.stevens@clearbayhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription top-up request + SOW attached

Michael — thanks for the details and the SOW. We can do this via a short-term private-offer top-up. Outline below to get everyone aligned quickly:

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Today (LA): Redwood to confirm feasible model/instance sizing and draft private-offer amendment. (Attachment: RBW_MAP_ClearBay_0707.xlsx)
- +2 business days: Redwood sends draft private-offer + DocuSign link for legal signoff.
- +5 business days: ClearBay procurement to return PO number and signed DocuSign.
- +7 business days: Marketplace private-offer accepted and billing starts; staged acceptance window begins (7-day functional smoke).

A few clarifications we need from procurement:
1) Do you require staged billing split (e.g., 50/50 first month) or a single tranche? We can support either; if staggered invoicing is needed we’ll include it in the amendment.
2) Are there any compliance evidence bundles (SOC2 report, network diagrams) that procurement needs attached to the private offer? We can pull the standard marketplace evidence set and add a brief operations note explaining KV/cache behavior during ramp.

I'll loop in Ben to finalize pricing and Kim to start the private-offer paperwork. If that timing works we can meet the 10-business-day target.

Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: RBW_MAP_ClearBay_0707.xlsx (mutual action plan template)

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Stevens <michael.stevens@clearbayhealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription top-up request + SOW attached

Michael — looping in procurement-level detail. Pricing for the 90-day committed uplift (estimated tokens) is below and assumes the same model family as your current private offer:
- Committed tokens: 180M tokens over 90 days
- Effective rate: $0.0009 per token (volume-discount applied)
- Estimated uplift cost (90d): $162,000

If you prefer staged billing we recommend a two-tranche invoice: 60% on activation / 40% at day 45. That helps align with your AR cadence and keeps usage reconciliation simpler.

Procurement checklist for marketplace private offer:
1) PO number and Exact Legal Entity name matching AWS account.
2) DocuSign signature on the private-offer amendment (we will provide the DocuSign).
3) If tax/VAT indexing is required, indicate billing country and remit instructions.
4) Evidence bundle accepted: SOC2 Type II PDF, signed Data Processing Addendum, and brief Ops runbook snippet (we'll attach).

I attached a PO checklist that tends to speed up acceptance. Once we have PO + signoff we can open the private-offer in AWS and request the Marketplace acceptance window.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO_Checklist.xlsx

---

From: procurement@clearbayhealth.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Stevens <michael.stevens@clearbayhealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription top-up request + SOW attached

Ben / Laura — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of notes from procurement:
- We will issue the PO (PO-98431) by Friday, Jul 16.
- We prefer two-tranche billing; please reflect 60/40 split in the amendment.
- For the evidence bundle, SOC2 PDF and the DPA are required. Ops runbook can be the short summary you offered.

We are OK with a 7-day staged acceptance window but would like Redwood to keep the early rollback window to 48 hours in case we see functional regressions during the ramp.

Once you share the DocuSign link and the amended private-offer reflecting PO-98431 we will get legal to sign immediately.

Procurement Team
ClearBay Health
procurement@clearbayhealth.com
